newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Coilombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,086.50.
newsitem.headline: Coilombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,086.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 2.30 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,086.50 after getting a boost from dollar-selling by banks, dealers said.
They said the selling was prompted by the fact that several large banks had overextended their dollar positions and were short local currency.
The dollar was widely expected to bounce back Tuesday, however, on demand from the corporate sector and traders seen jumping into the market for relatively cheap greenbacks.
Dealers reported 354 trades for a total of $174 million and said the peso hit an intraday low of 1,090.20 before moving higher into the close. The peso ended 1.50 off its session high of 1,085.00.
